package.description: Turn removable storage into physical game cartridges.

en-US.description: Turn removable storage into physical game cartridges.
en-US.longDescription:
A cartridge is a small drive in a pocketable enclosure with a game on it. Plug
it into a USB port and a launcher appears showing the game's cover art, with a
Play button and an Eject button.

A cartridge is an ordinary drive with a cartridge.conf text file at its root.
There are no scripts to write and nothing to allowlist, because nothing on a
cartridge is ever executed automatically - pressing Play is the gate.

Includes a wizard (pc-gamepak --create) that formats a drive, copies a game
onto it, fetches cover art, and checks every file it wrote by reading the
cartridge back and comparing CRC-32 sums.
en-US.name: PC GamePak
